title: flake: service-automation http-nodes「unknown host」用例依赖真实 DNS 查询，CI 上 5000ms 超时
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Filing gate: ① (b) flake found by L1-a on PR #38114 (#37828): CI run 46099207334, job 140838130836, Test Core (5/10), head 214577c9. The diff does not touch this package. Source: fleet.
Grading: area:build · Bug · p2 · reach: every PR whose Test Core shard runs service-automation; one red shard holds a PR out of review and out of the queue · evidence: one CI failure + code read.
Dedupe: "http-nodes no-such-host", "unknown host refusal timeout" → 0.

## 维护者速读

- 问题：自动化服务里有个测试，用一个不存在的域名检查「访问未知主机会被拒」。它真的去做了一次 DNS 查询，CI 上查询偶尔超过 5 秒，测试就超时变红，跟 PR 改了什么没关系。
- 修法：测试里把域名解析换成桩，不再依赖真实网络，被测的拒绝逻辑不变。
- 要你做的：无。

## Measured

- `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/http-nodes.test.ts:271`: "an unknown host reads the refusal a non-public target reads…" runs `http://no-such-host.invalid/path`. The test at l.293 also uses that host.
- The failure on job 140838130836 is a 5000 ms test timeout on the DNS lookup of `no-such-host.invalid`. PR #38114 does not touch this package.

## Ask

1. Both tests stub the host lookup (the resolver the egress check uses), so the unknown-host path is driven without a network. The refusal text and the "nothing of the lookup" assertion stay as they are.
2. An ablation that shows the stub is what the test exercises. For example, with the stub resolving to a public address, the test goes red.

## Acceptance

- `http-nodes.test.ts` makes no real DNS query. Run with networking off, it passes.
